column3: Asks: walk me through it; what did you hand to AI tools, what did you keep, and how did you know the result was right? Follow-up: where did you stop to check it yourself, and did anything go wrong?
column6: All four, none undone by a follow-up question or the record: (1) Owns it: authored or drove the work and can say where it stands, matching the repo record; (2) AI account: says what was and was not handed to AI tools; (3) Specific checks: names the checks that made that reasonable (tests, CI, review gates, staging, rollback, a held-out evaluation), not just "we had tests"; (4) A stop, or a lesson: names a point where they stopped to validate something hard to reverse (a schema, authentication, a deployment, a data migration, a data split, a save-file format) and why there, or a delegation that went wrong, the check it lacked, and the check now in their sprint notes or repo record.
